name: Crank Up ga Matenakute
original_name: クランクアップが待てなくて
source:
Ryousuke is a third grade school student who attends school cinema club and dreams of shooting a film. Finally he gets such opportunity. Now he needs to appoint the roles and find the main heroine for the film out of many worthy beautiful girl candidates.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
凉介是一名三年级学生，参加学校电影俱乐部并梦想拍摄电影。终于他得到了这样的机会。现在他需要指定角色，从众多值得信赖的美少女候选人中物色影片的女主角。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
